sections.Lycanthrope encounter rules:
Alternate Form (Su). Where available, take or leave an animal or hybrid form as a standard action. Equipment does not change. Entering either form heals as a day of rest. A slain lycanthrope returns to humanoid form where it has one, but severed parts keep their animal shape. An afflicted creature normally gains one alternate form and can struggle to control it.
Curse of Lycanthropy (Su). A qualifying bite to a humanoid within one size category requires Fortitude DC 18 or transmits the curse. Bludgeoning or nonpenetrating attacks cannot transmit it. Afflicted lycanthropes can spread it in Ravenloft. The general text specifies animal form, but a listed hybrid curse also uses this procedure at the table. Use any strain-specific exception below.
Natural lycanthropes generally have DR 10/silver in animal or hybrid form, while afflicted ones have DR 5/silver. Some strains name a different material. Low-light vision and scent work in any form unless the profile specifies otherwise. Lycanthropic empathy allows simple communication, gives a +4 racial bonus on attitude checks with the corresponding normal or dire animal, and permits simple commands to friendly animals.
A spellcaster cannot use verbal, somatic, or material components in animal form and cannot use verbal components in hybrid form. Apply the printed encounter stats for each form.

Attack. Tail slam +4 melee (1d2+2 plus poison). Full attack. Tail slam +4 melee (1d2+2 plus poison) or bite −1 melee (1d4+1).
Skills. Listen +11, Hide +6, Spot +11. Add a +10 racial bonus to Hide while prone on a sandy seabed. Feats. Alertness, Control Shape, Dodge, Iron Will.
Amphibious, DR 10/coral and stingray empathy.

sections.Lycanthrope encounter rules:
Alternate Form (Su). Where available, take or leave an animal or hybrid form as a standard action. Equipment does not change. Entering either form heals as a day of rest. A slain lycanthrope returns to humanoid form where it has one, but severed parts keep their animal shape. An afflicted creature normally gains one alternate form and can struggle to control it.
Curse of Lycanthropy (Su). A qualifying bite to a humanoid within one size category requires Fortitude DC 18 or transmits the curse. Bludgeoning or nonpenetrating attacks cannot transmit it. Afflicted lycanthropes can spread it in Ravenloft. The general text specifies animal form, but a listed hybrid curse also uses this procedure at the table. Use any strain-specific exception below.
Natural lycanthropes generally have DR 10/silver in animal or hybrid form, while afflicted ones have DR 5/silver. Some strains name a different material. Low-light vision and scent work in any form unless the profile specifies otherwise. Lycanthropic empathy allows simple communication, gives a +4 racial bonus on attitude checks with the corresponding normal or dire animal, and permits simple commands to friendly animals.
A spellcaster cannot use verbal, somatic, or material components in animal form and cannot use verbal components in hybrid form. Apply the printed encounter stats for each form.

ruleNotes: The tail slam’s poison appears in the full-attack line and the trait, but not in the single-attack row. Apply it to any tail slam.
